stage: Stage 6.2A.1 — Import Script Safety Audit & Correction

defects_identified: Original script lacked pre-import backup existence verification.
Original script lacked duplicate workflow detection prior to calling import.
Original script relied on default n8n active state rather than passing explicit --activeState=false.
Original script lacked deep post-import comparison (only checked for presence of workflow name in list).
Original script lacked execution guard (could run if invoked without parameters).
corrections_applied: Added check_preconditions() verifying local file integrity, pre-import backup presence, and live ingestion workflow health.
Added duplicate detection: warns if 'Bounded Dual-Stream Gated Retrieval' is already present and prevents duplicate workflow creation.
Added explicit '--activeState=false' argument to CLI import command.
Added comprehensive verify_and_compare() matching all 16 node IDs, names, types, typeVersions, parameters, connections, SQL thresholds, credentials, endpoints, and fallback text against local source.
Added execution guard requiring explicit '--execute' flag, allowing safe dry-run inspection via '--check-only'.

workflow_id_collision_check.mechanism: Local file omits top-level 'id' property. n8n CLI generates a new unique workflow ID upon import, guaranteeing existing ingestion workflow (IlBw4RRELuh02Akm) cannot be overwritten.

comparison_checks: Node IDs and names match exactly
Node types and versions match exactly
SQL query, thresholds (>= 0.70, >= 0.65), and LIMIT 2 verified
PostgreSQL credential reference verified as 'Postgres account'
Greeting branch verified terminal with zero database/LLM calls
Zero-result branch verified terminal with exact fallback text
Zero credentials exposed in comparison output

confirmation_import_not_executed: CONFIRMED: Neither scripts/import_retrieval_workflow.py nor any n8n workflow import command was executed. Live n8n instance and database remain 100% in their pre-import state.
